claim_scope: Low-budget randomized alternative-circuit search for 63 fixed C25/C29 patterns and cyclic orders, followed by exact direct and quotient-preserving affine-orbit coverage within the same fresh packet. Retained certificates and coverage edges are exact, but the search is not exhaustive and does not prove an all-order obstruction, geometric realizability, a counterexample, or Erdos Problem #97.

configuration.stopping_rule: continue only if a compressed clause has width at most the configured threshold and is absent from the prior compression packet, or directly/affinely covers another fresh target
